description_en: Queries the attribute information of a specified ECS instance
description_zh: 本接口用于查询一台指定ECS实例的属性信息
name: DescribeInstanceAttribute

ClusterId.description_en:
The ID of the cluster to which the instance belongs.
This parameter will be deprecated soon. To ensure future compatibility, use other parameters
ClusterId.description_zh:
实例所在的集群ID。
该参数即将被弃用，为提高兼容性，请尽量使用其他参数

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC. For more information, see [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）
CreationTime.description_zh: 实例创建时间。以ISO 8601为标准，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。更多信息，请参见[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）

CreditSpecification.description_en:
The running mode of the burstable instance. Valid values:

Standard: standard mode. For more information about instance performance, see [Performance mode](~~59977#section-svb-w9d-dju~~). 
Unlimited: unlimited mode. For more information about instance performance, see [Performance mode](~~59977#section-svb-w9d-dju~~)
CreditSpecification.description_zh:
突发性能实例的运行模式。可能值：

Standard：标准模式。有关实例性能的更多信息，请参见[性能模式](~~59977#section-svb-w9d-dju~~)。 
Unlimited：无性能约束模式，有关实例性能的更多信息，请参见[性能模式](~~59977#section-svb-w9d-dju~~)

DedicatedHostAttribute.description_en: The dedicated host attributes, which consist of the dedicated host cluster ID (DedicatedHostClusterId), dedicated host ID (DedicatedHostId), and dedicated host name (DedicatedHostName)
DedicatedHostAttribute.description_zh: 由专有宿主机集群ID（DedicatedHostClusterId）、专有宿主机ID（DedicatedHostId）和名称（DedicatedHostName）组成的宿主机属性数组

DedicatedHostId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated host

DedicatedHostName.description_en: The name of the dedicated host

EipAddress.description_en: The Elastic IP Address (EIP) binding information

Bandwidth.description_en: The public bandwidth limit of the EIP. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 弹性公网IP的公网带宽限速，单位为Mbit/s

InternetChargeType.description_en:
The billing method for public bandwidth. Valid values:

PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth.
PayByTraffic: pay-by-traffic.

In pay-by-traffic mode, the peak inbound and outbound bandwidths are used as the upper limits of bandwidths instead of guaranteed performance metrics. When resource contention occurs, the peak bandwidths may be limited. If you require guaranteed bandwidth, use the pay-by-bandwidth mode
InternetChargeType.description_zh:
公网带宽计费方式。可能值：

PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽计费。
PayByTraffic：按使用流量计费。

按使用流量计费模式下的出入带宽峰值都是带宽上限，不作为业务承诺指标。当出现资源争抢时，带宽峰值可能会受到限制。如果您的业务需要有带宽的保障，请使用按固定带宽计费模式

EnableJumboFrame.description_en:
Indicates whether the Jumbo frame feature is enabled for the ECS instance. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: not enabled.

For more information, see [ECS instance MTU]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200512.html）
EnableJumboFrame.description_zh:
ECS实例是否开启了Jumbo frame特性。 可能值：

true：开启。

false：不开启。

更多信息，请参见[ECS实例MTU]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200512.html）

EnableNetworkEncryption.description_en:
Indicates whether VPC network traffic encryption is enabled for the instance. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false: not enabled.
This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available
EnableNetworkEncryption.description_zh:
实例是否开启VPC网络流量加密，可能值：

true：开启。
false：未开启。
该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC. For more information, see [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 过期时间。以ISO 8601为标准，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。更多信息，请参见[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the image that the instance is running

IpAddress.description_en:
The list of internal network IP addresses of the classic network type instance.

The classic network is deprecated. For more information, see [Deprecation notice]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html）
IpAddress.description_zh:
经典网络类型实例的内网IP地址列表。

经典网络功能已下线，详情请参见[下线公告]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html）

items.description_en: The internal network IP address of the classic network type instance
items.description_zh: 经典网络类型实例的内网IP地址

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
InstanceChargeType.description_zh:
实例的计费方式。可能值：
PrePaid：包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费

InstanceNetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values: 
         
vpc: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).
classic: classic network. The classic network is deprecated. For more information, see [Deprecation notice]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html）

classic：经典网络。经典网络功能已下线，详情请参见[下线公告]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html）

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type of the instance

InternetMaxBandwidthIn.description_en: The maximum inbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s

IoOptimized.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is I/O optimized. Valid values:

optimized: I/O optimized.

none: not I/O optimized

The network-related attributes.

BandwidthWeighting.description_en:
The bandwidth weight.

Different instance types support different values. You can call [DescribeInstanceTypes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679699.html） to query the bandwidth weight values supported by the current instance type

不同规格支持设置的值不一样，您可以通过[DescribeInstanceTypes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679699.html）查询当前实例规格支持的带宽权重值

LockReason.description_en:
The lock reason. Valid values:

financial: The instance is locked due to overdue payment.
security: The instance is locked due to security reasons.
Recycling: The spot instance is locked and pending release.
dedicatedhostfinancial: The ECS instance is locked because the dedicated host has an overdue payment.
refunded: The instance is locked because a refund has been made
LockReason.description_zh:
锁定原因。可能值：

financial：因欠费被锁定。
security：因安全原因被锁定。
Recycling：抢占式实例的待释放锁定状态。
dedicatedhostfinancial：因为专有宿主机欠费导致ECS实例被锁定。
refunded：因退款被锁定

IpAddress.description_en: The list of public IP addresses of the instance

items.description_en: The public IP address of the instance

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The security groups to which the instance belongs

items.description_en: The security group to which the instance belongs

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the instance

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:

Pending: being created.
Running: running.
Starting: being started.
Stopping: being stopped.
Stopped: stopped
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值范围：

Pending：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Starting：启动中。
Stopping：停止中。
Stopped：已停止

StoppedMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance continues to be billed after it is stopped. Valid values:

KeepCharging: The instance continues to be billed after it is stopped. Resources such as vCPUs, memory, and public IP addresses are retained.
StopCharging: The instance is not billed after it is stopped. Resources such as vCPUs, memory, and public IP addresses are released. Whether the instance can be restarted depends on resource availability in the current region.
Not-applicable: The instance does not support the economical mode
StoppedMode.description_zh:
实例停机后是否继续收费。可能值：

KeepCharging：停机后继续收费，为您继续保留库存资源。
StopCharging：停机后不收费。停机后，我们释放实例对应的资源，例如vCPU、内存和公网IP等资源。重启是否成功依赖于当前地域中是否仍有资源库存。
Not-applicable：本实例不支持停机不收费功能
